title: Ordinary identity scalar extension has its normalized derived unitor on all complexes
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, and X a scheme, with independent scheme and coefficient universes. The recorded ordinary derived scalar extension along the identity of E admits a natural isomorphism to the identity functor. On the localization Q(P) of every cochain complex P, its hom component is the specified derived scalar counit followed by Q applied to the specified cochain multiplication unitor. This assertion constructs the isomorphism and its formula; uniqueness on the good-complex localization is a separate argument in the parent theorem.

proof.text: The existing cochain multiplication unitor identifies ordinary identity scalar extension on cochains with the identity. Whisker with Q. The resulting functor inverts quasi-isomorphisms, so its universal left-derived counit is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Compose that derived counit with the cochain multiplication unitor and the functor unitors. Fully faithful precomposition by Q gives a unique preimage natural isomorphism of derived functors. Its map-preimage equation is exactly the required formula on Q(P), for every complex P.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryUnitOnComplexes_exists :
    ∃ e : completedDerivedScalarExtension l E E (AlgHom.id ℚ_[l] E) X ≅ 𝟭 _,
      ∀ P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E X) ℤ,
        e.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) =
          completedScalarCounit l E E (AlgHom.id ℚ_[l] E) X P ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map ((completedScalarIdentityMultiplication l E X).hom.app P)
